summary: FlatMate+ v3 backend + frontend regression completed. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass across two suites — old regression (swipe/match/messages/WS, updated to include face_descriptor) and new v3 suite (geo/search, non-negotiables, liveness descriptor rules, profile face-verify match/mismatch, housing gate for have_house, PATCH /profile/edit (ignores name), discover primary/nearby buckets, live filter food, non-negotiable food_pref hard filter, fallback_message when primary empty). Frontend smoke at viewport 420x900: Landing loads; /api/geo/search returns 6 shaped results; login->discover redirect works; Discover filters sheet opens with all filter-* testids (radius, budget, food, smoking, drinking, housing, apply, reset); applying filters re-queries /discover and shows badge count; EditProfile /edit-profile prefills current user, name disabled, bio & work_schedule PATCH persist via /profile/edit, /auth/me confirms name unchanged; Onboarding shows 8-step progress (1/8) with ob-* testids.
passed: GET /api/geo/search?q=indira returns list with primary/city/lat/lng (6 results, first: Mahipalpur, Delhi)
PUT /api/onboarding accepts all new fields (work_schedule, home_lat/lng, radius_km, office_locality/lat/lng, male_guests_ok, family_visits_ok, hosts_parties, flat_preferences)

POST /api/liveness/verify: rejects missing/short face_descriptor (400); accepts 128-float descriptor; face_descriptor_selfie NEVER returned by /auth/me
PUT /api/profile: main photo without descriptor -> 400; mismatched (random) descriptor -> 400 with 'match'; matching descriptor -> 200 with main_photo_verified=true
PUT /api/profile housing gate: have_house without flat_photos -> 400 'flat'; with flat_photos -> 200
PATCH /api/profile/edit updates age/bio/radius_km/work_schedule/interests; drops unknown 'name' key (pydantic model has no name -> ignored)

Non-negotiable food_pref hard-filters mismatched candidates from discover buckets
fallback_message set when primary empty and nearby has results
Backend regression (updated): swipe mutual match returns clean JSON (no _id), matches list has other+last_message, messages send+list chronological, WS broadcasts new message to receiver
Frontend Login->Discover redirect + filters sheet with all filter-* testids opens; apply re-queries
Frontend EditProfile prefills, name disabled, PATCH persists (bio & work_schedule verified via /auth/me), name field unchanged

issues: activeFiltersCount counts radius_km + budget_min + budget_max as separate 'active' entries even when a user just opens+applies with defaults, so the badge shows 4 after applying only 'food=veg'. Consider counting only user-changed filters vs defaults.
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Add SheetDescription or aria-describedby for a11y.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_profile: face_descriptor_main is popped from upd via upd.pop after model_dump but the model already includes it — currently works but relies on ProfileUpdate having face_descriptor_main field; keep in sync.

server.py update_profile: profile_complete requires photos AND prompts AND housing_ok, but on subsequent PATCHes without photos/prompts (e.g., only editing bio) it would recompute using prev photos/prompts — actually this is /profile only; /profile/edit doesn't touch it. OK.
compute_match still returns 'score' — no longer shown on card (SwipeCard omits it) but sent in payload; harmless but consider omitting from /discover items too.
server.py geo/search: relies on external Nominatim; returns [] on any exception which is fine but users on rate-limit will silently see no results. Consider surfacing a hint.

EditProfile.jsx: refreshUser called after PATCH — good; but /profile/edit doesn't re-run profile_complete recalc, so if user edits housing_status from need_house->have_house without adding flat_photos, they may bypass the gate that /profile enforces. Consider re-validating in PATCH endpoint too.
